title: Keep interactive literature retrieval responsive
description: Moves network retrieval off the OpenCode event loop, uses fast source fallback for interactive searches, and applies bounded source timeouts.
changes: Run the Python retrieval subprocess asynchronously so API and SSE events remain available.
Stop interactive source traversal after the requested unique-paper count is reached.
Keep full multi-source traversal for systematic mode.
Reduce individual source timeout and retry budgets.
Cap interactive retrieval at 45 seconds and systematic retrieval at 90 seconds.

rollback.notes: Restore synchronous exhaustive multi-source retrieval and the prior client retry budgets.
